title: Stop AI From Clicking the Wrong Button -- 6-Layer Target Safety Net
desc: L1: ambiguous pattern matches multiple windows -> list + hwnd auto-heal. L2: modal alert blocking -> auto-find buttons inside. L3: FOCUSED/LEAF terminal node -> suggest grab target. L4: Win32 child not found -> list siblings (MFC/HTS). L5: no #scope on element action -> root children + focus chain. L6: UIA scope element miss -> list available elements.
steps: Layers 1-3 cover ambiguous targets: L1 ambiguous pattern matches multiple windows -> list candidates and auto-heal by hwnd; L2 modal alert blocks the action -> auto-find buttons inside the modal; L3 a FOCUSED/LEAF terminal node is detected -> suggest grabbing the focused target.

Layers 4-6 cover scoping mistakes: L4 Win32 child not found -> list siblings (helps MFC/HTS dialogs); L5 element action invoked without #scope -> dump root children + focus chain so the user can pick; L6 UIA scope element miss -> list elements available inside that scope.
Each layer fails 'soft' with a structured suggestion instead of a click — the AI must read the suggestion and re-issue a precise grap before any action is taken.
